Brand Radar measures AI visibility by running 471M+ search-backed prompts through AI platforms (AI Overviews, AI Mode, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot) and storing every response.
Your visibility is then calculated from how often your brand is mentioned or cited in those responses, with these key metrics:

- Citations – how often AI links to your pages or domains as a source

content.text:
## Best AI search visibility tools for brands (August 2026)

The strongest choice depends on whether you need **broad measurement**, **enterprise monitoring**, **competitive share-of-voice data**, or **actionable optimization**.

| Tool | Best for | Why consider it |
|---|---|---|
| **Ahrefs Brand Radar** | SEO teams and brands already using Ahrefs | Measures AI mentions, citations, estimated impressions, and AI Share of Voice across Google AI Overviews, AI Mode, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Copilot. It uses large volumes of search-backed prompts rather than only manually created prompts. [Ahrefs](https://ahrefs.com/brand-radar) |
| **Semrush AI Visibility Toolkit** | Existing Semrush customers and integrated SEO workflows | Combines AI visibility scoring, competitor research, prompt research, brand sentiment, Share of Voice, prompt tracking, and an AI-search site audit. [Semrush](https://www.semrush.com/kb/1493-ai-visibility-toolkit) |
| **Profound** | Large brands, agencies, and enterprise intelligence teams | A specialist platform focused on answer-engine monitoring, prompt tracking, citations, competitor analysis, and enterprise reporting. Public pricing shows a $99/month ChatGPT-only tier, $399/month tier covering three engines, and custom enterprise coverage. [Profound pricing](https://www.tryprofound.com/pricing) |
| **Peec AI** | Mid-market marketing teams wanting transparent pricing | Focuses on AI search analytics, visibility trends, competitor comparisons, and multi-model tracking. Its pricing page advertises tracking for up to 11 LLM models, with API access available on higher-level plans. [Peec AI](https://peec.ai/pricing) |
| **Scrunch AI** | Enterprise GEO and optimization infrastructure | A good fit when monitoring needs to connect with structured brand/entity data, technical optimization, and larger-scale workflows. It is generally positioned as an enterprise platform rather than a lightweight tracker. [IndustryLens comparison](https://industry-lens.com/intelligence/ai-search) |
| **AthenaHQ** | Mid-market teams seeking automated on-page GEO improvements | Best suited to brands that want recommendations or automation around content, schema, entities, and technical changes—not just reporting. [Rankability comparison](https://www.rankability.com/blog/best-ai-search-visibility-tracking-tools/) |
| **Otterly AI** | Small teams and beginners | A lower-complexity way to track brand mentions and citations in AI answers. It is commonly positioned as a budget-friendly starter tool. [Rankability comparison](https://www.rankability.com/blog/best-ai-search-visibility-tracking-tools/) |
| **Nightwatch** | Teams wanting traditional SEO plus AI monitoring | Combines LLM monitoring with conventional rank tracking, prompt research, citation-level sentiment analysis, and brand monitoring. [Nightwatch](https://nightwatch.io/blog/best-ai-search-monitoring-tools/) |

### My practical recommendations

- **Best overall for an SEO-led brand:** **Ahrefs Brand Radar**
- **Best if your team already uses Semrush:** **Semrush AI Visibility Toolkit**
- **Best enterprise specialist:** **Profound**
- **Best mid-market analytics platform:** **Peec AI**
- **Best for actually implementing GEO changes:** **AthenaHQ** or **Scrunch AI**
- **Best low-cost starting point:** **Otterly AI**
- **Best combined SEO and AI-search monitoring:** **Nightwatch**

### What to evaluate before buying

1. **Engines covered:** ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews/AI Mode, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot, and Claude do not produce identical results.
2. **Prompt methodology:** Prefer platforms using both your own high-value prompts and large, search-backed prompt datasets. Ahrefs, for example, says Brand Radar uses hundreds of millions of search-backed prompts. [Ahrefs](https://ahrefs.com/brand-radar)
3. **Mentions versus citations:** A brand can be mentioned without receiving a clickable citation. Track both.
4. **Share of Voice:** Make sure the tool compares you with competitors, not merely reporting raw mentions.
5. **Geography and personalization:** Country, language, device, logged-in state, and search settings can materially change AI answers.
